verdict.rationale: Devin can analyze repository data and provide AI-powered, context-grounded answers to questions about one or more repos (devin-docs-27), and its MCP tools let it explore/query documentation across codebases (devin-docs-16), which counts as data-driven AI insights within its coding domain. However, this is scoped narrowly to code/repo data rather than general business data or dashboards, and there's no evidence of proactive suggestion/insight generation beyond query-response. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive/unprompted insight generation, support for non-code data sources, and independent validation of insight quality.
